source_reconciliation.coverage_failure: The retained subset contains five candid street observations but only one deliberate close portrait. It has no recurring approved person, look or environment and cannot source six unique fashion-shot joint chains including clean identity, sculptural three-quarter, interference and connected material detail without invention.
source_reconciliation.needs_source: Additional original frames from one intentional hard-sun monochrome street fashion shoot: a recurring person and look, clean visible-face hero, environmental full figure, sculptural three-quarter pose, one real foreground interference frame, a connected hand/material detail and a wide campaign coda.

candidate_observations.environment: Public streets, plaza and market surfaces under hard daylight, plus one reflective shopfront; locations are not proven to be one place.
candidate_observations.lighting: Hard daylight and strong black-white separation recur, but direction and subject treatment vary by location.
candidate_observations.contrast: High contrast with deep blacks, bright pavement and visible fine grain or scan texture.
optical_facts: No EXIF lens or exposure metadata is present.
Frame-04.jpg uses shallow portrait separation while frames 07 and 14 use much broader street depth.
Frame-11.jpg uses a reflective glass layer; it is the only retained candidate interference source.
